answer: Random audit with slashing: each epoch the chain randomly picks 5% of agents and a fresh jury re-checks their recent answers against the seeds. Every agent stakes 50 POA to mine, and the operator pays: a failed audit slashes the whole stake, so running n fakes means n stakes at risk and expected loss grows with fleet size. Reward nectar only flows after passing. Failure case: a farm that tints each fake answer with new pigment to look unique still gets sampled; one cluster caught in the nebula of near-copies loses every linked stake.
